distribution.summary: 安徽；重庆；福建；广西；贵州；河北；黑龙江；香港；湖南；江苏；江西；吉林；宁夏；陕西；上海；山西；四川；西藏；云南；浙江；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Heilongjiang, Jilin, Shaanxi, Anhui, Fujian, Sichuan, Hunan, Yunnan and Xizang. 黄复生等 (2015) adds Taiwan. Smith et al. (2020) confirms much of this range and adds Chongqing, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hebei, Hong Kong, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shanghai, Shanxi and Zhejiang. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Current host synthesis follows the detailed 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) species- and genus-level host evidence. Smith et al. (2020) contributes distribution evidence only in the promoted record. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as polyphagous on gymnosperms and angiosperms; this broad statement remains contextual and does not add host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborinus saxesenii (Ratzeburg, 1837).
